Class RoundRecorder

java.lang.Object
dev.swordai.client.RoundRecorder
final class RoundRecorder extends Object
Every round of /swordai fight, tick by tick, for working out afterwards why a round was lost and what the opponent did: the distance, both swords, the keys and which rule pressed them, how the opponent moved, and every hit either way with what kind it was likely to be. A round ends with a death on either side. Each is written to swordai/fights as a small gzipped text file, a summary on top and the timeline below, and a line goes to swordai/fights/rounds.csv. Only the newest KEPT rounds are kept, a few megabytes at most.

The user, 18 October: store more of the fights "so when I tested it on my friends again you can see the round it lose and know exactly the reason it fails and what opponent is doing".
